Steamy South Florida Forecast: Daily Thunderstorm Rounds and Sizzling 90s Ahead

By
South Florida Reporter
-
Sep 8, 2026
Facebook
Twitter
Pinterest

Linkedin
ReddIt
    Listen to audio version of this article
    Sponsored by
    0:00 / 2:58
    Instaread

    Tuesday features more clouds than sun and plenty of late afternoon and evening showers and storms in the East Coast metro area.  The Gulf Coast will see mostly sunny skies with a few morning showers and some afternoon and evening storms.  The Keys will be mostly sunny with a few showers and storms in spots.  Tuesday’s highs will be near 90 degrees — but it will feel much hotter, so stay hydrated and out of the sun.

    Wednesday will bring mostly sunny skies and afternoon showers and storms to the mainland.  The Keys will see a mix of sun, some clouds, and a few showers and storms in spots.  Wednesday’s highs will be in the low 90s on the mainland and near 90 degrees in the Keys.

    Thursday will feature mostly sunny skies and afternoon and evening showers and storms on the mainland, while the Keys will be mostly sunny with the chance of a shower or storm.  Thursday’s highs will be near 90 degrees.

    Friday will be mostly sunny with midafternoon to early evening showers and storms on the mainland.  The Keys will see a mix of sun and clouds with the chance of a stray shower or storm.  Friday’s highs will be in the low 90s in the East Coast metro area and near 90 degrees along the Gulf Coast and in the Keys.

    Saturday’s forecast calls for a mix of sun, clouds, and periods of showers and storms again.  Highs on Saturday will be in the low 90s in the East Coast metro area and near 90 degrees along the Gulf Coast and in the Keys.

    It’s still quiet in the tropical Atlantic.
